newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ZWACK SAYS BLACK MARKET HIT 1996 PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: ZWACK SAYS BLACK MARKET HIT 1996 PROFITS.

text.p: said on Friday a smaller legal domestic alcoholic
drinks market and a failure to curb black market sales had
conrtibuted to a drop in 1996 operating profit.
"The legal drinks market continued to shrink as in previous
years," Zwack said in its preliminary 1996 earnings report.
"Measures announced by the government to push back the black
market did not show any result last year."
The company said a bumper fruit crop in the summer had led
to an increase in home-made liquor and led to a dramatic fall
The company, most famous for its flagship drink Unicum,
reported its IAS consolidated operating profit falling to 952
million forints from 1.02 billion in 1995 despite an increase
in net sales to 8.29 billion forints from 6.94 billion in 1995.
